integrity: The proof uses an analytic concavity argument, direct spherical radial convolution and two projection obstructions. The included exact-rational checker is corroborative, not an exhaustive proof; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three positive frequency parameters only; no quantitative Gram eigenvalue bound; a bounded literature comparison leaves risk of an earlier equivalent Bessel-product specialization.
title: Triangle closure criterion for three-frequency radial sinc kernels
